integration_revision: R10I v3 corrects two shared zero-world defects exposed by the 802763b3 candidate-schedule gate stage: the shared development walking evaluator admitted the neutral_stance_entry segment only for the R10H neutral policy, so the R10I joint-pose entry session could never finalize, and the shared candidate-schedule finalizer fixture bound legacy BW5R-B identity instead of the selected entry's native identity. The evaluator now admits the selected joint-pose entry policy for that segment and the fixture binds the selected entry's native policy. The 802763b3 gate failure is preserved with no physical child. Core, DLL, entry math, runtime command behavior, task criteria and held-out fixtures are unchanged.
